SECTION 3 GREEN (the Fubini step at 1 < Re s): etaIntegral_eq_Gamma_etaSeries (h1 : 1 < s.re) : etaIntegral s = Complex.Gamma s · etaSeries s. Mechanism: pointwise kernel expansion etaKernelC t = (t:ℂ)^{s-1} · ∑' n, laplaceTerm s n t (tsumAltExp: 1/(e^t+1) = ∑ (-1)^{n-1} e^{-nt}, ‖x‖ < 1 with x = e^{-t}); integrability of each laplaceTerm (indicator form + MellinConvergent.comp_mul_left scaling of the exp(-·) base, const_smul for the (-1)^{n-1}); summable norm-integrals via exact Laplace values; Fubini via hasSum_integral_of_summable_integral_norm; term integrals = Gamma(s)·n^{-s} (laplaceTermIntegral, n=0 case 0, n≥1 case the real gamma integral); tsum rearrangement to Gamma(s)·etaSeries s (tsum_mul_left, (n:ℂ)^{-s} = 1/(n:ℂ)^s via Complex.cpow_neg, n≠0 case 0^s = 0^(-s) = 0 via Complex.cpow_eq_zero_iff).

SECTION 4 GREEN (explicit truncation bound, all 0 < Re s): etaStripTruncationBound (hs : 0 < s.re) (N) (hN : 1 ≤ N) : ‖etaStrip s − etaPartial s N‖ ≤ (2 + ‖s‖/s.re) · (N:ℝ)^{−s.re}. Mechanism: etaStripTendsto (Phase 2.2c) + Tendsto.sub_const + continuous_norm, then by_contra + a gap/2 ball: if the bound failed by gap > 0, eventually all partial sums would lie in the ball of the limit of radius gap/2, contradicting Phase 2.1 etaTailBound's eventual bound B on ‖etaPartial s M − etaPartial s N‖ (Filter.eventually_atTop.mp + Metric.mem_ball).

FIX LEDGER (what actually differed from the 0501 handoff draft - all verified in the green build): (1) the real gamma integral is Real.integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_Ioi (0 < a.re form: ∫₀^∞ x^{a-1} e^{-b x} dx = b^{-a} Γ(a)) - the draft's integral_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_rpow name does not exist in this pinned Mathlib; with a := 1 and b := n the (1/n)^σ = n^{−σ} bridge is one_div + Real.rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow. (2) Complex.power continuity with VARIABLE exponent needs ContinuousOn.cpow with the slitPlane hypothesis (fun t ht => by simpa using ht for 0 < t) - ContinuousOn.const_cpow is the constant-base family and does not apply. (3) ‖(r : ℂ)‖ = |r| is RCLike.norm_ofReal (bare norm_ofReal does not resolve in this context); (Real.exp x : ℂ) = Complex.exp x is ofReal_exp (there is no top-level exp_ofReal); ‖exp x‖ = Real.exp x is norm_exp_ofReal. (4) (-1:ℂ)^n = (-1:ℂ)^{n-1}·(-1:ℂ) needs n destructured as k+1 (obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n-1, by omega⟩; pow_succ) - pow_add with n-1 directly does not close. (5) the geometric series sum uses Real.exp (-t) < 1 via Real.exp_lt_one_iff (no exp_neg_lt_one in this Mathlib) + summable_geometric_of_lt_one / tsum_geometric_of_norm_lt_one. (6) integrability of the indicator form goes through integrable_indicator_iff + aestronglyMeasurable_indicator_iff + ContinuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable (MellinConvergent is definitionally IntegrableOn). (7) summability of the tail series: Real.summable_nat_rpow at exponent −s.re < −1.
